title: Austin's Airport, Civic, & Convention Futures
summary:
*   **Major Airport Funding Approved:** The city accepted over $13 million in Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) grants. Funds are earmarked for acquiring property for a new Austin airport and for significant airfield and terminal improvements at Robert Mueller Airport.
*   **Key Development Projects Discussed:** The council continued discussions on the proposed Austin Civic Center project, including payments for professional services. A report was also presented on the comprehensive review and financial planning for a proposed convention center.
*   **Pedestrian Safety Infrastructure:** Staff, Metro, and AISD were directed to identify funding sources to ensure the continuation of a pedestrian overpass on US 183, addressing local infrastructure needs.

Mayor Pro Tem Shipman called to order the special called meeting of the Council, noting

GILBANE UPDATE
Wendell Holmes presented the Gilbane Update concerning the proposed Austin Civic Center
Project.
Postponed to the September 29, 1988 Council meeting are two resolutions: (1) Consider
payment to Gilbane Building Company (Project Manager), Page Southerland Page (Project
Architect) and Coopers & Lybrand (Project Financial Planner) for professional services
related to the Austin Civic Center Project after May 12, 1988. (2) Consider amending
Section 3.01 of the contract between the City of Austin and Coopers & Lybrand (financial
planner) relating to reimbursables for travel and lodging in connection with the Austin
Civic Center Project.
FAA GRANTS
The Council, on Councimember Carl-Mitchell's motion, Councilmember Nofziger's second,
adopted two resolutions accepting the following Grants: (4-0 Vote, Mayor Cooke,
Councilmembers Humphrey and Urdy absent) a. A Federal Aviation Administration Grant in the
amount of $10,000,000.00 for property acquisition for the New Austin Airport.
b.
A Federal Aviation Administration Grant in the amount of $3,384,621.00 for airfield
improvements and terminal area improvements at Robert Mueller Airport.
